sloka: सद्योपलब्धिर्गर्भस्य प्रसूतिः सद्य एव च ।सद्य एव वयःप्राप्तिर्मातुरेव वयस्समम् ।। ७.४.३१ ॥
transliteration: sadyopalabdhirgarbhasya prasūtiḥ sadya eva ca ।sadya eva vayaḥprāptirmātureva vayassamam ।। 7.4.31 ॥

translations.english: The boon granted by Uma was that conception would be immediate, birth would be immediate, and the child would immediately attain an age equal to that of its mother.
